categories.blurb: Clear, respectful, solution-focused language that improves teamwork, reduces conflict and builds a site where problems get solved constructively.

contents.label: VOC forms, one per machine (16)
contents.note: Excavator, dozer, wheel dozer, grader, wheel loader, skid steer, articulated haul truck, rigid dump truck, water cart, roller, scraper, telehandler, forklift, elevating work platform, light vehicle 4WD and service truck. Each form is complete on its own: candidate and machine details, eligibility check, observation record, knowledge questions, decision, feedback, and the declaration and signatures.
